# A slice read at an offset must not be written in the same loop. A recurrence
# (a[i] = a[i-1] + b[i]) carries a value from one iteration to the next, and a
# store to a slice that another statement reads at an offset changes what the
# vector loop would read. Offsets that are not the same on every iteration, a
# stride, and a store at an offset are left alone too. StoredAhead is safe, since
# it only reads elements ahead of the one it writes, but telling it from a
# recurrence needs a dependence test, which loopvec does not have yet.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists ops_simd.go
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig

loopvec -json .
cmpenv stdout stdout.want

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func Recurrence(a, b []int32) {
	for i := 1; i < len(a); i++ {
		a[i] = a[i-1] + b[i]
	}
}

func StoredElsewhere(a, b, c []int32) {
	for i := 0; i < len(a)-1; i++ {
		a[i] = b[i]
		c[i] = a[i+1]
	}
}

func StoredAhead(a, b []int32) {
	for i := 0; i < len(a)-1; i++ {
		a[i] = a[i+1] + b[i]
	}
}

func Strided(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := 0; i < len(dst)/2; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[2*i]
	}
}

func OffsetFromSlice(dst, a, b []int32) {
	for i := 0; i < len(dst); i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i+int(b[0])]
	}
}

func OffsetAssigned(dst, a []int32, off int) {
	for i := 0; i < len(dst); i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i+off]
		off++
	}
}

func StoreAtOffset(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := 0; i < len(dst)-1; i++ {
		dst[i+1] = a[i]
	}
}

func OffsetFromIndex(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := 0; i < len(dst); i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i+i]
	}
}
